entries.text_de:
Das Phillipps-Ms. 807912 vom Anf. des 14. Jhs. gehört jetzt der Universität Cambridge n. 3392.

F. 1 Henr. Huntendun. bis 1147; f. 82 Tripartita, d. i. Wl art, u. S. 486; f. 82b ECf retr, u. S. 627; Geneal. Normannica. Dann Huntingdon De summitatibus.
entries.text_en:
The Phillipps MS 807912, from the beginning of the 14th century, now belongs to the University of Cambridge, n. 3392.

F. 1 Henr. Huntendun. to 1147; f. 82 Tripartita, i.e. Wl art, below, p. 486; f. 82b ECf retr, below, p. 627; Geneal. Normannica. Then Huntingdon, De summitatibus.

notes.text_de: vgl. ebd. S. 131 und über den sonstigen Inhalt Catal. of mss. of Phillipps, June 1896, für die Auction von Sotheby, Wilkinson and Hodge, n. 610.
notes.text_en: cf. ibid. p. 131, and on the other contents Catal. of mss. of Phillipps, June 1896, for the auction by Sotheby, Wilkinson and Hodge, n. 610.

notes.text: Contains Henry of Huntingdon to 1147, then the Tripartita (Wl art, ECf retr, Genealogia Normannica) and Huntingdon's De summitatibus.
